game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the sleigh.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the sleigh. Each round, snow wraiths strike the sleigh, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel: keep the vault meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: vault drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while vault > 0.
